zones.description: Residential towers and perimeter blocks located near major transport corridors provide compact urban housing with underground parking and protected inner courtyards.
Medium-rise mixed-use blocks with grocery store, cafés, pharmacies, and local services on ground floors ensure daily amenities within walking distance.
Flexible office and coworking spaces create employment opportunities and support the multifunctional redevelopment concept of the former industrial territory.
Preserved factory chimneys and reconstructed industrial buildings adapted for galleries, workshops, and public cultural functions maintain the site's industrial heritage.
Integrated kindergarten with safe play courtyards and community rooms positioned centrally within the residential quarter.

zones.purpose: linear park and public open space
zones.description: East-west linear park with pedestrian and cycling paths, stormwater landscaping, playgrounds, and seating areas forms the main public spine of the redevelopment.
Green acoustic buffer, mobility hub, and access roads along Entuziastov Highway reduce traffic noise and improve pedestrian safety near transit connections.

facts: The zoning plan maintains building heights up to 30 floors.
Green and open public spaces exceed the minimum requirement of 15% of the territory.
Historic industrial chimneys and selected factory structures are preserved and adaptively reused.
Noise mitigation measures are concentrated along Entuziastov Highway.
The redevelopment includes at least one kindergarten and a grocery store within walking distance.
Ground floors along main streets are dedicated to active commercial uses.
The linear park creates a continuous east-west pedestrian and cycling connection through the site.
